layers.authority: Dirección de Áreas Protegidas, Ministerio de Energía y Ambiente de Mendoza
layers.process: Aconcagua Provincial Park, summer season 2026-2027: ascent and long-trek permits are sold through the park's registered service companies (Aconpass or the SIO system). Promotional prices for foreign visitors from the advance sale (14 to 30 September 2026): ascent by Quebrada de Horcones US$950 (about A$1,349), long trek by Horcones US$450 (about A$639), ascent by Quebrada de Vacas US$1,290 (about A$1,832), all at RBA, 30 October 2026: A$1 = US$0.7040. Dollar prices are paid in Argentine pesos at the Banco de la Nación buying rate of the day before payment. Fees are not refunded and named permits can't be transferred, but an unused permit can be used in a later season if the evacuation insurance is renewed. Registration needs passport, expedition form, risk acceptance, proof of payment and evacuation insurance. General season prices are set by a separate decree, not yet read.

layers.authority: Dirección de Áreas Protegidas, Ministerio de Energía y Ambiente de Mendoza
layers.process: Ascent and long trek in Aconcagua Provincial Park need insurance or an evacuation service covering search, rescue, evacuation and medical costs. Policies must be in Spanish or English, show a policy number, and cover adventure-sport activity up to 5,500 m (Nido de Cóndores camp).

layers.authority: Dirección de Áreas Protegidas, Ministerio de Energía y Ambiente de Mendoza
layers.process: High-risk activities in Aconcagua Provincial Park (the South Face ascent, glacier skiing, paragliding, BASE jumping and similar) can be authorised only from 1 November to 20 December and from 1 February to 30 April. Apply at least 30 working days ahead (about 42 calendar days), declaring routes and itineraries.

layers.authority: Dirección de Áreas Protegidas, Ministerio de Energía y Ambiente de Mendoza
layers.process: Aconcagua winter season (1 May to 31 October) activities need authorisation by resolution. Foreign visitor prices: ascent US$2,500 (about A$3,551), long trek US$1,000 (about A$1,420), short trek US$500 (about A$710), at RBA, 30 October 2026: A$1 = US$0.7040.

laws.rule: In Aconcagua Provincial Park, high-risk sports (South Face ascent, glacier skiing, paragliding, BASE jumping and any activity riskier than ordinary trekking and climbing) are banned from 20 December to 1 February. Breaches can bring immediate suspension, a ban on new authorisations for the season and sanctions under Provincial Law 6045 on protected natural areas.

Mendoza's provincial protected areas charge entry by origin (Argentine, Latin American, other foreign). Examples for other foreign visitors: Caverna de las Brujas full circuit ARS 20,000; La Payunia traditional circuit ARS 20,000, Payún Matrú or Payún Liso climb ARS 70,000; Laguna del Diamante lagoon sector ARS 20,000, Volcán Maipo climb (up to 7 days, camping included) ARS 150,000; Puente del Inca, Divisadero Largo, Bosques Telteca and Ñacuñán ARS 10,000. Under 12s enter free. Entry fees don't include guides, who are compulsory on most circuits. (No RBA rate for ARS; at the Banco Central de la República Argentina rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 1,078.2486 ARS: ARS 10,000 ≈ A$9.27; ARS 20,000 ≈ A$18.55; ARS 70,000 ≈ A$64.92; ARS 150,000 ≈ A$139.11)
